text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm not gonna dance! Why don't you
just
dance by yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I brought her to the dance studio
because I
figured she could use some
extra dance lessons,
but... this is how it's
been going.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Like I care! I'm busy gathering magical
energy
over here!
choice_data_list: 君が踊らないと意味ないよ……
貴方が踊らないと意味ないよ……

text_block_list.text:
Oh, then wouldn't dancing be perfect?! I
gather
energy through dancing, myself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's dance to "Princess ☆
Party"! It's
the ending theme of the third
season of Princess
Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's easier to just see for yourself! Here
goes!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
HIIIYAAAH!
Ha, ho, hyah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The heck?! There's so much energy
coming off
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess dances vigorously
until there's
steam rising off of her. It
looks just like magical
energy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What do you think? Could you
see my
amazing princess energy? ☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! Show me how to do it right
away! I'm
gonna store so much energy!
You'll see!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ♪ Throw it off with all your
might! ♪ It's the
fighting princess way! ♪
choice_data_list: （まぁ、ダンスの練習にはなるか！）
（まぁ、ダンスの練習にはなるよね！）

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone, gather around the tiara! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep and Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Energetic princess! ♪ Ho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I feel kinda warm and fuzzy! Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! You're full of energy! Your face
has
changed as well!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, it was exciting! Do you know any
more cool
dances like this? Please show
me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right! Times like this call for...
choice_data_list: 休憩しなくても大丈夫？
さらにエネルギーが溜まる踊りがあるよ

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oregano Recovery! I'll just drink some of
this
magic water and blow my fatigue
away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Recharge complete! Now I can dance at
extra full
power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess Sweep Tosho is enjoying herself,

considering she keeps dancing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You know one?! Nice going, Familiar!
What kind
of dance is it?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Concerts are huge masses of energy! It
sounds
like we can expect to power up
even more!
choice_data_list: ライブで踊るダンスなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I like the sound of that!
Familiar! Hurry
up and play the music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho works hard at her dance
practice
until it gets quite late!
